subject: E-Commerce
title: Why People Buy Foreign
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Why People Buy Foreign.

hook.text: 67% of cross-border shoppers buy foreign products because they're cheaper. Price arbitrage drives global shopping.

buildup.text: Consumers also buy foreign products that aren't available locally. Niche goods find global audiences online.

discovery.text: K-beauty fans in the US order skincare directly from South Korea. Japanese stationery ships to collectors worldwide.

twist.text: Cheaper prices often don't account for shipping and import duties. The 'deal' can vanish after customs fees.

climax.text: People cross borders for price, variety, or uniqueness. But hidden costs can erase every perceived saving.

punchline.text: 67% buy foreign for the price. Hidden fees make many 'deals' more expensive.

quiz.question: What is the main reason people buy from foreign e-commerce stores?
options: Lower prices compared to local options
